section: Summary of Benefits for the Standard Option of the Government Employees Health Association, Inc. - 2026

rows.Standard Option Benefits: Medical services provided by physicians: Diagnostic and treatment services provided in the office
rows.You pay: In-network: $20 copay primary care provider; $35 copay specialist for covered office visits Out-of-network: 40%* of covered professional services

rows.Standard Option Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Inpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: 15%* of covered hospital charges Out-of-network: 40%* of covered hospital charges

rows.Standard Option Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Outpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: 15%* of covered hospital charges Out-of-network: 40%* of covered hospital charges
In Network: 30%* of the Plan allowance Out of Network: 30%* of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.Standard Option Benefits: Mental health and substance misuse disorder treatment:

rows.You pay: Network pharmacy, 30 day supply: • Generic - $10 copay • Preferred Brand - 40% up to $350 • Non-Preferred Brand - 60% up to $450
Mail order pharmacy, 90 day supply: • Generic - $25 copay • Preferred Brand - 40% up to $700 • Non-Preferred Brand - 60% up to $900
Network preferred pharmacy, 30 day supply: • Generic - $9 copay • Preferred Brand - 25% up to $200 • Non-Preferred Brand - 50% up to $300
